reviewer.conflict_declaration: The reviewer did not implement the runner or evidence corrections and performed a read-only review of the exact committed delta.

methods: Verified the exact reviewed revision and clean working tree before and after review.
Reviewed only the correction delta and the committed controlled-pilot report.
Ran the official validator and all four negative fixtures.
Independently recomputed the four case digests and the report digest.
Matched the recorded runner hash to the reviewed runner and verified revision ancestry.
Checked all source Git-state and snapshot before/after pairs and the effect audit.

resolved_findings.summary: The original runner accepted an arbitrary output path.
The original evidence did not record enough provenance or source mutation checks.
The original validator accepted self-attested fields without strict shape and effect-audit checks.

verified_evidence: Four real-repository subsets were observed in read-only mode under public-safe aliases.
All source Git-state and snapshot digests were unchanged before and after each run.
All four cases remained observe_suggest and produced zero allowed technology drafts.
The only runner write was creation of one new mode-0600 JSON file in an allowed temporary root.
The committed report contains no raw source path or raw source content.
unresolved_nonblocking_limits: Three private source trees were dirty but remained unchanged during observation.
Private input authenticity cannot be independently replayed from the public artifact.
The evidence does not establish extraction correctness, organizational benefit or scientific effectiveness.
The effect audit is application-level rather than an external operating-system syscall trace.
No external human peer review was performed.
attestation: An isolated AI-assisted reviewer who did not implement the reviewed changes verified the exact correction revision and found no remaining release-blocking pilot-evidence defect.
claim_boundary: This owner-authorized AI-assisted review supports the controlled observe/suggest pilot gate only. It is not external human peer review, production-write authorization, proof of extraction correctness or a release decision.
